name: TS Demo Importer
author: themeshopy

sections.description:
Set up your WordPress website quickly and effortlessly with TS Demo Importer, the official demo import plugin developed by Theme Shopy. Designed to simplify the website creation process, this plugin allows you to import professionally designed demo websites in just one click. Whether you’re a beginner creating your first website or a developer working on multiple projects, TS Demo Importer helps you get started within minutes by importing demo content, layouts, widgets, menus, and theme settings automatically.

The plugin is primarily built for Theme Shopy’s Multi Advance Theme, allowing users to explore multiple ready-made website demos across different industries and instantly import the layout that best suits their business. Instead of building every page from scratch, you can start with a complete website structure and customize it according to your needs.

Effortless Website Setup in One Click

TS Demo Importer eliminates the time-consuming process of manually creating pages, menus, widgets, and homepage layouts. With its easy-to-use setup process, the plugin installs the required demo content and configures your website to closely match the live demo, helping you launch your website much faster.

Whether you’re creating a business website, online store, portfolio, blog, agency website, or service-based website, TS Demo Importer provides a smooth and hassle-free setup experience.

Key Features

  • One-Click Demo Import – Import demo content, pages, menus, widgets, homepage layouts, and theme settings with a single click.
  • Built for Theme Shopy Themes – Optimized to work seamlessly with compatible Theme Shopy WordPress themes.
  • Designed for Multi Advance Theme – Easily import multiple professionally designed demos available within the Multi Advance Theme.
  • Beginner-Friendly Setup – No coding or technical knowledge required.
  • Fast & Reliable Imports – Quickly recreate demo websites while maintaining performance and stability.
  • Responsive Demo Layouts – Import modern, mobile-friendly website designs ready for customization.
  • Regular Updates – Continuous improvements for better compatibility with the latest WordPress versions.
  • Plugin Compatibility – Works smoothly alongside popular WordPress plugins for extended website functionality.

Why Choose TS Demo Importer?

TS Demo Importer is designed to save time and simplify website creation. Instead of spending hours recreating layouts manually, you can import a complete starter website and begin customizing your content immediately. The plugin is ideal for freelancers, agencies, developers, and business owners who want a faster way to build professional WordPress websites.

As the official importer for Theme Shopy, it ensures reliable compatibility with supported themes while providing a consistent and user-friendly import experience.

Supported Themes

TS Demo Importer supports a growing collection of Theme Shopy themes, including selected Free WordPress Themes, Premium WordPress Themes, and the Multi Advance Theme. Where supported, users can quickly import professionally designed starter websites across a variety of business categories, helping reduce setup time and providing a solid foundation for further customization.

Get Started Today

Launch your website faster with TS Demo Importer and experience a simpler way to build WordPress websites. Import professionally designed demo websites in just one click and start customizing your site instead of building it from scratch.

To explore additional website designs, layouts, and compatible demos, you can browse Theme Shopy’s collection of Premium WordPress Themes and the WordPress Theme Bundle, which offer a wider range of professionally designed templates for different industries and website types.

Contributors & Developers

TS Demo Importer is open-source software developed and maintained by Theme Shopy. We continuously improve the plugin to ensure compatibility, performance, and an excellent user experience for WordPress website creators.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the ts_demo_importer.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
